casual.definition:
s. marked by blithe unconcern
s. without or seeming to be without plan or method; offhand
s. appropriate for ordinary or routine occasions
s. occurring or appearing or singled out by chance
casual.translation:
a. 偶然的, 不经意的, 便装的
n. 临时工, 待命士兵

casual conditions.translation: [法] 偶然条件, 偶成条件

casual ejector.translation: [法] 假定的被告, 名义被告

casual inspection.translation:
[计] 不定期检查
[化] 不定期检查; 临时检查

casual loss.translation: [经] 临时损失, 偶然发生的损失

casual water.translation: n. （因下雨等）临时出现的水区

casualism.definition:
n. The doctrine that all things exist or are controlled by
   chance.
casualism.translation: n. 偶然说, 机缘说

casualist.definition: n. One who believes in casualism.
casualist.translation: n. 机缘说, 偶然说；偶然状态 (casualism的变形)

casualities.translation: (casuality 的复数) n. 因果律

casualization.translation: n. 转为雇用临时工制, 雇用临时工制

casually.definition:
r. not methodically or according to plan
r. in an unconcerned manner
casually.translation: adv. 偶然地, 临时地, 随便地

casuals.translation: n. [复数]便鞋( casual的复数形式 ); [军事]待命士兵; 没有固定工作的劳动者; [英国英语][亦作C-]（穿着休闲服、政治上较偏激的）休闲暴力者

casualties.definition:
n someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement
n someone injured or killed in an accident
n an accident that causes someone to die
n a decrease of military personnel or equipment
casualties.translation: n. 伤亡；人员伤亡（casualty的复数）

casualty.definition:
n. someone injured or killed or captured or missing in a military engagement
n. someone injured or killed in an accident
n. a decrease of military personnel or equipment
casualty.translation:
n. 意外事故, 伤亡, 受害者
[化] 事故

casualty account investigation report.translation: [法] 事故伤亡调查报告书

casualty department.translation: n. （医院专门负责救护事故、灾害伤者的部门）

casualty insurance.translation: [经] 意外保险, 伤害保险, 灾害保险

casualty ward.translation: [医] 临时病室, 重伤病室

casualy.translation: adv. 不拘礼节地；漫不经心地；随意地

casuariiformes.definition: n. a ratite bird order: cassowaries and emus

casuarina.definition: n. any of various trees and shrubs of the genus Casuarina having jointed stems and whorls of scalelike leaves; some yield heavy hardwood

casuarinales.definition: n. order of chiefly Australian trees and shrubs comprising the casuarinas; 1 family: Casuarinaceae

casuarinas.definition:
plural of casuarina
n. any of various trees and shrubs of the genus Casuarina having jointed stems and whorls of scalelike leaves; some yield heavy hardwood
casuarinas.translation: (casuarina 的复数) n. 木麻黄

casuarius.translation: [网络] 鹤鸵属；犀鸟亚科；食火鸡

casuist.definition: n. someone whose reasoning is subtle and often specious
casuist.translation: n. 决疑论者, 诡辩家

casuistic.definition:
a. of or relating to or practicing casuistry
a. of or relating to the use of ethical principles to resolve moral problems
casuistic.translation: a. 决疑的, 诡辩的

casuistical.definition:
a of or relating to or practicing casuistry
a of or relating to the use of ethical principles to resolve moral problems
casuistical.translation: a. 决疑的, 诡辩的

casuistics.translation: n. 决疑论, 良心论

casuistry.definition:
n. argumentation that is specious or excessively subtle and intended to be misleading
n. moral philosophy based on the application of general ethical principles to resolve moral dilemmas
casuistry.translation: n. 决疑论, 决疑法, 诡辩

casuists.definition:
plural of casuist
n. someone whose reasoning is subtle and often specious
casuists.translation: (casuist 的复数) n. 决疑论者, 诡辩家

casuitically.translation: adv. 决疑地, 诡辩地

casus.definition:
n. An event; an occurrence; an occasion; a combination of
   circumstances; a case; an act of God. See the Note under Accident.
casus.translation:
n. 案例
[法] 案例, 原因, 事故

casus belli.translation: n. 宣战的事件, 开战的原因

casus foederis.translation: [法] 依条约或契约所规定者

casus major.translation: [法] 严重事故, 重大事故

casusbelli.translation: 开战的理由, 宣战的借口
